title: PWCore
description: A mod about PWGood with quests and other content!
body:
**PWCORE**

This mod adds a lot of content dedicated to the PWGood, and also adds quests to make the process even more interesting!

_JEI is recommended for the game to learn crafting recipes._

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The mod features a quest menu, with a certain number of stars awarded for completing quests (there are 22 in total).
There's an attribute system that allows you to level up.
Interesting items such as notes and magnets have been added.
The GNDR dimension has been added (don't look for anything there, there's nothing there).
And much more!

</details>

This mod adds 2 new ores, magnets, notes, a new painting, a quest system, a custom set of armor and tools.
